text:
Aisha: Heads-up — getting reports of SSO auth failures for ~12 Private VPC onboarding tenants. Seeing a cluster of 401s during the SAML assertion step. Need a customer-facing status and ETA. Who can confirm scope?

Tom: looking now. initial logs show repeated 'invalid_assertion' from our IdP client after a cert rollover window. snippet:```auth.error=invalid_assertion idp=corp-idp tenant=tenant-xyz trace=abc123```

Ilya: I'm on it. if cert rollover is the suspect I'll coordinate a rollback for the client library. spinning up a fix branch, will validate on staging first. ETA ~45m for rollback + verification.

Priya: CS needs a short, non-technical status we can send to affected customers. Keep it 1-2 lines and include mitigation if possible.

Nora: Draft for CS: "We're aware of SSO login errors impacting some Private VPC onboardings. Our engineers are investigating and we expect a fix within the hour; we'll update here with confirmed next steps. If you need immediate access, please reach out and we can enable a temporary email login or API key for your team." Thoughts?

Aisha: Good start. Do NOT mention certs, rollbacks, or root cause in customer comms yet. Keep language confidence-focused and offer immediate workaround.

Tom: Agreed. Also flag: some tenants are hitting the error repeatedly; adding short-term throttle so retries don't amplify the issue. Added a rate-limit patch to the proxy configs.

Ilya: Confirming rollback on staging succeeded. Running smoke tests. If green I'll push to prod in next 20m and monitor. After prod rollback I'll post a postmortem plan + RCA timeline (we aim to share within 48hrs).

eng-incident-bot: incident created #INC-2026-322; priority P2; assigned to Ilya.

Priya: CS action items: 1) Send status note to affected tenants (Nora), 2) Offer workaround and triage calls for high-touch customers (Aisha/Priya), 3) Track credit/renewal risk flags for any customers affected >2 hours (Aisha).

Nora: Sending initial status email template now to the list provided by ProdOps. I'll include the workaround steps and a scheduled office hours window at 30m and 90m.

Aisha: Good. Please keep the message short and include: what we know, what we're doing, expected timeline, workaround, and contact path. No speculation about RCA.

Tom: after rollback I'll run a quick sweep for any stale sessions and clear KV caches for affected routes. Logging hook will be extended for more granular tenant ids.

Ilya: Prod rollback complete — monitoring shows auth success for 9/12 tenants within 5m of the change. Continuing to monitor for the remaining 3. Will post when all green.

Aisha: Thanks team. Once we have all green, we'll send a closure note + next steps (RCA ETA: 48hrs). Keep a list of any customers asking for credits/renewal conversations and tag me.

Priya: Noted — building a short feedback capture form to gather impact and any downstream enablement gaps for those tenants. Will link in the closure note.

Nora: Update sent to affected tenants. Short version: "We're investigating an SSO login issue for some Private VPC onboardings. Engineers are actively working on a resolution; we have a workaround available. We'll follow up with a full update and RCA soon."

Ilya: final prod check shows all 12 tenants authing successfully now. Logging looks clean. I'll open the formal RCA draft and post on the incident channel in ~2 hours for review.

Aisha: Great. After the RCA draft is reviewed we will coordinate the customer-facing post-incident note and the feedback survey. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
